def is_magic(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    if not n or any(len(row) != n for row in grid): return False
    if sorted(v for row in grid for v in row) != list(range(1,n*n+1)): return False
    target = n*(n*n+1)//2
    return all(sum(row)==target for row in grid) and all(sum(grid[i][j] for i in range(n))==target for j in range(n)) and sum(grid[i][i] for i in range(n))==target and sum(grid[i][n-1-i] for i in range(n))==target

steps.text: Set n to the length of grid.
Check whether not (n) or any((len(row) != n for row in grid)). Return False.
Check whether the sorted values of (v for row in grid for v in row) differs from list(range(1, n * n + 1)). Return False.
Require every row, column and both diagonals to sum to the same target.
